expected_findings.summary: The refund handler is async but not wrapped in asyncHandler and has no try/catch; if payments.refund or the DB calls reject, Express 4 never calls next(err), the promise rejection is unhandled and the request hangs (and a partial refund may go unrecorded). Wrap it in asyncHandler or catch and forward with next(err).

must_stay_silent_on.reason: Handler is wrapped in asyncHandler, which forwards rejections to next().
